about.title: About Me
about.lead: I enjoy turning an idea into a clear structure, then shaping that structure into a working and carefully made product.
about.body: My current focus is building web experiences with React, Next.js and TypeScript. This portfolio is not only a place to show work; it is a living project where I apply what I learn about interaction, 3D web and performance.
